name: Meissen Hildegarde
original_name: マイセン＝ヒルデガルド
source:
Alicia's older brother.
He appears in Mahoutsukai no Goshujin-sama, Arabians Lost, and Crimson Empire. He has sub events in all three visual novels, endings in Mahoutsukai no Goshujin-sama, and Arabian's Lost, but has never received a full route.
